question: A and B start simultaneously from two places 60 km apart and travel toward each other at speeds of 4 km/h and 6 km/h, respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (Unit: hours)
solution: Let them meet after \(t\) hours. Then \(4t+6t=60\). Solving gives \(t=6\).
